locked.shell: white / off-white; SITE 00 red default; bottom nav
locked.feel: a project room — not Asana, not Jira, not a generic client portal

client_app_grammar.rule: /app: white bg, off-white #fafafa, max-width 430px centered, 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) header rule, Martian Mono, accent #e8192c; "not admin, not generic SaaS, not website UI 1:1". No image authority in repo.

host_vs_project_rules.rule: Host chrome (top bar, bottom nav, mode bar, type, red) stays constant across projects; project identity appears via thumbnail, hero media, boards content, world imagery.
--site00-project-presence-accent defaults to host accent; project skins (NDXBOOK lime/black, JURNL bone/emerald) live inside project surfaces only.
Do not crop finished screens into runtime assets; authority images are QA/reference only, never shipped as UI.

typography.rule: SITE 00 host typography (public site, design reconstruction, client app, tokens): Martian Mono via Google Fonts (wdth 75–112.5, wght 100–800), default width 87.5 semi-condensed; weights label 600, heading 700, display 800, numeric 650.
Production workspace host (pxh/pxa/pw/ibx/a-): Saira Semi Condensed self-hosted woff2 300–700, Martian Mono only as fallback.
Character Fabrication: "SITE00 Fab Condensed"/Barlow Condensed (declared specialization).
Martian Mono is host-only; never client brand canon (HOST_UI cannot become CLIENT_BRAND). JURNL uses Barlow Semi Condensed + Instrument Serif; NDXBOOK uses its own editorial faces.
Tracking restrained (display 0, label 0.06em, nav 0.04em); Production chrome letter-spacing 0.04em.

derived_rules: One primary thing per screen; the authority under review dominates
Light and quiet: white/#fafafa, 1px rules, red only for attention and primary action
No card walls; sections read as an editorial page
Project personality enters through the project marker and the work itself
Never show internal agent chat, prompts, model names, token usage, debug or internal costs
authority_status: INCOMPLETE — CSS claims P0.APP.1 reference fidelity but the reference image is not tracked in the repo. Founder should supply it.
